# `network/chunks/ChunkLimits.js`

> **Source:** `engine/network/chunks/ChunkLimits.js`

network/chunks/ChunkLimits.js — size ceilings/defaults (network plan §27).

## Constants

- `MAX_CHUNK_BYTES` — Network-wide hard ceiling for one logical chunk. Not the default — a ceiling.
- `DEFAULT_CHUNK_BYTES` — Sensible default chunk size (§27: "512 KB-1 MB").
- `DEFAULT_FRAGMENT_BYTES` — Default transport fragment size (§27/§28; matches WebRTC DataChannel's assumed default `max-message-size`).
- `MAX_FRAGMENT_BYTES` — Experimental larger fragment size for trusted high-bandwidth links.
- `CONTROL_MAX_BYTES` — Soft caps for non-bulk message classes (§27).
- `MANIFEST_MAX_BYTES`
